title: Warmly Steamed Australian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting lentil stew featuring Australian ingredients, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel using mushimono steam, perfect for a midnight craving. This shojin-friendly dish is jammy and shattering, with a rich and satisfying flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the red lentils, vegetable broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the cataplana vessel with a lid.
Steam the stew over low heat for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the stew has thickened.
Remove the cataplana vessel from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
